title: 第 704章 灭杀离火鸠第703 章 全面提升
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行舟起身走出密室，眼中却掠过一丝无奈。
两年过去，云沧那边始终没有消息传来，想来应该是未曾得到地图，否则对方断不可能放弃赤月灵花。
距离秘境虚弱期已不足半年，他决定提前动身，前往风暴海域外围等候。
他收拾妥当，出了小院，行至城中摆摊区，各色吆喝叫卖之声不绝于耳。
陆行舟目光随意扫过，却被一处普通摊位上的几瓶妖兽灵血瞬间吸引了注意力，脚步骤然顿住。
他的神识悄然放开，落在那三瓶泛着淡淡赤红光晕的玉瓶之上。
瓶中妖血隐隐透着一缕极其微弱却极其精纯的火道血脉气息，正是他苦苦寻觅已久朱雀精血。
摊主是一名老者，结丹后期巅峰的修为，他很是好奇此人是如何获得四阶妖兽灵血的。
陆行舟缓步走上前去，指着妖血，淡然问道：“这是什么妖血？”
老者感受到陆行舟散发出的元婴气息，连忙躬身行礼，声音发颤：“前……前辈，这是四阶离火鸠的灵血。”
陆行舟点了点头，开口道：“这三瓶灵血，我要了，什么价格？”
老者眼中闪过一丝欣喜，犹豫再三：“晚辈……晚辈，想换一份结婴灵物。”
“结婴灵物？”
陆行舟眉头微挑，一声轻哼，语气中带着几分讥讽：“小友，你真当四阶灵血是什么稀有宝物不成？还是觉得我不识行情，漫天抬价？”
老者见他面色转冷，顿时吓得心神俱震，连忙慌忙解释：“前辈恕罪，晚辈知晓此灵血不值这个价，我愿将摊位上所有灵材宝物尽数奉上，再加一百三十万灵石，只求前辈能赐下一份结婴机缘。”
陆行舟轻轻摇头，神色淡漠：“寻常灵材、灵石，于我而言毫无用处。”
见老者眼中满是失落，垂首颓丧，他话锋一转：“不过，你若如实告知我这离火鸠灵血的来历出处，我可以赐你一份结婴灵物。”
老者闻言，猛地抬头，眼中爆发出璀璨的光芒，急忙说道：“晚辈数日前出城猎妖，途经一处岛屿，远远撞见两头四阶妖兽厮杀，二者拼到最后两败俱伤，双双负伤遁走，岛上遗留了大量妖血，晚辈搜集了沾染妖血的沙石泥土，用秘术提炼，这才获得了三瓶离火鸠的灵血。”
陆行舟心中恍然，难怪一介结丹修士能得四阶妖禽灵血，原是捡漏。
他心中暗道，如此看来，那只身负朱雀血脉的离火鸠必然身受重创，肯定会找地方疗伤，短时间内绝不会远遁。

若能找到这只妖禽，将其猎杀，提炼出一些朱雀精血，他便可以修炼焚天裂空爪，又能多一道底牌。
他一直没有修炼，就是因为含有朱雀血脉的妖兽太稀有了，如今好不容易见到，哪有错过的道理。
陆行舟看向老者，沉声道：“带我前去那处荒岛，你所言若是属实，我便给你一份婴灵水。”
老者脸上瞬间浮现迟疑之色，那片海域常有四阶妖兽出没，凶险万分。
可一想到梦寐以求的结婴灵物，想到自己数十年，寿元耗尽便只会化作一抔黄土。
他终究咬牙咬牙，拱手道：“好，没问题。”
说罢，老者快速收拾摊位，将三瓶灵血恭敬递到陆行舟手中。
片刻后，两人出了石城，陆行舟祭出飞天梭，带着老者，按照他的指引，朝着东方海域疾驰而去。
两人后，他们抵达老者所言的岛屿外围。
content_en:
Lu Xingzhou stood up and walked out of the secret room, but a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
Two years have passed, and there has been no news from Yuncang. It must be that the map has not been obtained, otherwise the other party would never be able to give up the Red Moon Spirit Flower.
It was less than half a year before the weak period of the secret realm, so he decided to leave early and wait outside the storm sea area.
He packed up, left the small courtyard, and walked to the stall area in the city, where the sounds of shouting and hawking could be heard all the time.
Lu Xingzhou's eyes glanced casually, but his attention was instantly attracted by a few bottles of monster spirit blood on an ordinary stall, and his steps suddenly stopped.
His consciousness quietly let go and landed on the three jade bottles with a faint red glow.
The demon blood in the bottle faintly revealed an extremely weak but extremely pure breath of fire bloodline. It was the Suzaku blood essence that he had been searching for for a long time.
The stall owner is an old man with a peak cultivation level in the late stage of pill formation. He is very curious about how this person obtained the spiritual blood of a fourth-level monster.
Lu Xingzhou walked forward slowly, pointed at the demon blood, and asked calmly: "What kind of demon blood is this?"
The old man felt the Nascent Soul aura emanating from Lu Xingzhou, and quickly bowed and saluted, his voice trembling: "Senior...senior, this is the spiritual blood of the fourth-level Li Huojiu."
Lu Xingzhou nodded and said, "I want these three bottles of spiritual blood. What's the price?"
A trace of joy flashed in the old man's eyes, and he hesitated again and again: "Junior...Junior, I want to exchange for a baby spirit item."
"A baby-creating spiritual creature?"
Lu Xingzhou raised his brows slightly and hummed softly, with a hint of sarcasm in his tone: "Little friend, do you really think that fourth-level spiritual blood is some kind of rare treasure? Or do you think that I don't know the market and am raising the price all over the place?"
When the old man saw that his expression turned cold, he was immediately frightened and hurriedly explained: "Senior, please forgive me. I know that this spiritual blood is not worth the price. I am willing to offer all the spiritual materials and treasures on the stall, plus 1.3 million spiritual stones, in the hope that senior can give me a chance to have a baby."
Lu Xingzhou shook his head slightly, with an indifferent expression: "Ordinary spiritual materials and spiritual stones are of no use to me."
Seeing that the old man's eyes were full of loss and his head was downcast, he changed the subject and said, "However, if you truthfully tell me the origin of this Lihuojiu spiritual blood, I can give you a baby-creating spiritual object."
Hearing this, the old man suddenly raised his head, his eyes bursting with bright light, and hurriedly said: "The junior went out of the city to hunt monsters a few days ago. Passing by an island, he encountered two fourth-level monsters fighting in the distance. They fought to the end, both of them were injured, and both escaped with injuries. A large amount of demon blood was left on the island. The junior collected the sand and soil stained with demon blood, refined it with secret techniques, and then obtained three bottles of Lihuojiu's spiritual blood."
Lu Xingzhou suddenly realized that it was no wonder that a pill-forming monk was able to obtain the spiritual blood of a fourth-level demon bird because he had missed it.
He secretly thought, from this point of view, Li Huojiu, who has the blood of Suzaku, must have been seriously injured. He will definitely find a place to heal his wounds and will never escape in a short period of time.
If he could find this demonic bird, hunt it down, and extract some of the Suzaku essence and blood, he could practice the Sky-Burning Claw and gain another trump card.
He has never practiced because monsters with Suzaku bloodline are too rare. Now that they are finally seen, there is no reason to miss them.
Lu Xingzhou looked at the old man and said in a deep voice, "Take me to that deserted island. If what you say is true, I will give you a portion of Infant Spirit Water."
A look of hesitation instantly appeared on the old man's face. Level 4 monsters often appeared in that sea area, which was extremely dangerous.
But when I think about the coveted spiritual object that will form a baby, I think about how my life span will turn into a handful of loess after decades of depletion.
He finally gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, no problem."
After saying that, the old man quickly cleaned up the stall and respectfully handed three bottles of spiritual blood to Lu Xingzhou.
After a while, the two of them left the stone city. Lu Xingzhou launched his flying shuttle, taking the old man with him and speeding towards the eastern sea according to his guidance.
After two people, they arrived at the outskirts of the island that the old man mentioned.
